title: The packaging of the parts!
text:
The packaging of the parts!. The product is well built and only took half an hour or less to put together. But, add to that another 45 minutes, scissors, broken finger nails, screwdrivers, razor blades and a glass of wine (bad combination of course) to get the screws etc out. They're vacuum sealed on a cardboard backing, but after you cut each from the cardboard, they're each again vacuum packed around each item, which makes it impossible to cut them out.

Love the product, but won't ever order from this company because of the difficulty at getting to the parts. Also my back hurts from hunching over the parts, trying to free them.
